description: Check whether the main AI search crawlers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and Google can reach a website: the robots.txt rule for each one, and a firewall test that requests the home page with each crawler's user agent and compares the answer with a normal visit. Returns each crawler with pass or fail and copy-paste fixes. Reads robots.txt and the home page only. Free, no key. Rate limited per connection.

url.description: The website address, for example example.com or https://www.example.com/.

name: ai_crawler_check
title: AI crawler access check
